description: Team of teenagers working together on the 2026 Space Apps Challenge!
summary: expedition interstellar is a co-operative 2-4 player game for ages 10 and up that helps educate and interest people in space. our game has 2 different roles, ground control and astronouts. expedition interstellar takes place over 2 phases, the launch phase where both ground control and the astronouts help prepare for launch, and the mission phase where the ground control is helping the astronouts while they are in space.
details: expedition interstellar is a co-operative 2-4 player game for ages 10 and up that helps educate and interest people in space. our game has 2 different roles, ground control and astronouts. expedition interstellar takes place over 2 phases, the launch phase where both ground control and the astronouts help prepare for launch, and the mission phase where the ground control is helping the astronouts while they are in space. our team considered replayability as a big factor so people would want to play our game more.
